column1: # Curated: the region codes plates carry, per set, as code=label:weight[:sub] (weight roughly the population in thousands; sub is the number of offices or cities numbered under the code, for the S and C tokens). A code written !code is reserved: no authority issues it, and safe plates use it. US, CA and AU are the jurisdictions whose formats differ. From national registration rules and population statistics.
